translations.settings.thresholds.title: Activity thresholds
translations.settings.thresholds.intro: Two bounds, three states. The thresholds change the interpretation, never the SHAs or the counters already captured.

translations.activity.view.title: Activity register
translations.activity.view.subtitle: the bar measures the silence since the last commit · the dot marks the last activity · the bands come from the policy
translations.activity.view.draftNote: Thresholds explored here only · the saved policy stays {$INTERPOLATION}
translations.activity.view.rule: Rule applied: a protected or excluded pattern beats everything and classes the branch as "Excluded". Otherwise a branch that still holds its own commits stays "Keep", and moves to "Review" as soon as it is inactive or diverges. A merged or in-sync branch holds no own commit any more: its scale shortens to {$INTERPOLATION} d / {$INTERPOLATION_1} d, and it reads "Done", "Review", then "Cleanup possible". The coloured bands trace the whole policy: a row marked with a clock reads on its own shortened scale, not on the band it crosses.
